'''1999 Battle of Midway''' was a Star Wars CCG open held in Binghamton, NY on 7 August 1999. [[Chris Terwilliger]] won it. It is known from Brian Terwilliger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d5">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-12-binghamton-new-york-8-7-99d5/ binghamton-new-york-8-7-99], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 12 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-12-binghamton-new-york-8-7-99d5/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Binghamton, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 38
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Terwilliger]]
